主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. has been notified of an unsolicited mini-tender offer by TRC Capital Corporation to purchase up to 3,000,000 Class A Limited Voting Shares at Cdn $34.50 per share, a 4.46% discount to the Toronto Stock Exchange closing price on August 27, 2013. The offer is conditional and may be terminated if the share price declines after that date. Brookfield does not endorse the offer and advises shareholders to reject it. The Canadian Securities Administrators and the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission have raised concerns about mini-tender offers, warning investors to understand the terms and consult financial advisors. Brookfield, a global alternative asset manager with over $175 billion in assets under management, emphasizes the importance of current market quotations and professional advice.
